crossRefs.note: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

translations.web: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
translations.bsb: Like an archer who wounds at random is he who hires a fool or passerby.
translations.kjv: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
translations.asv: As an archer that woundeth all, So is he that hireth a fool and he that hireth them that pass by.
